title: Counting Hamiltonian Sturm permutations: generating functions and Gaussian distributions
summary: Our combinatorial analysis is motivated by the PDE dynamics \begin{equation} \mathbf{u_t} = \mathbf{u_{xx}} + \mathbf{g}(\mathbf{u}),\qquad 0<\mathbf{x}<1, \end{equation} of solutions $\mathbf{u}=\mathbf{u}(\mathbf{t},\mathbf{x}),\ \mathbf{t}\geq 0$, under Neumann boundary conditions. For dissipative nondegenerate nonlinearities $\mathbf{g}$, the global attractors $\mathcal{A}=\mathcal{A}_\mathbf{g}$ of the PDE can then be classified by the orderings of their $2n+1$ equilibria $\mathbf{v}$ at the boundaries $\mathbf{x}=0,1$. We encode the boundary orders as Hamiltonian Sturm permutations.…
